# 3D game tech

Engines, R3F ecosystem, games to learn from, shaders and atmosphere, state/AI/audio, and the asset pipeline.

Stars checked 2026-09-23. Notes: [notes/3d-tech.md](../notes/3d-tech.md). Sync locally: `node scripts/sync.mjs --category 3d-tech`

### Engines & renderers

| Repo | ★ | License | What it is | What we take from it | Sync |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| [mrdoob/three.js](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js) | 116k | MIT | The JavaScript 3D library (WebGL/WebGPU/WebXR). | Base renderer; examples/jsm has Sky, PointerLockControls, water, lens flare, post passes. | docs |
| [pmndrs/react-three-fiber](https://github.com/pmndrs/react-three-fiber) | 32.4k | MIT | React renderer for three.js. | Scenes as React 19 components; useFrame game loops; mount in a client component. | docs |
| [BabylonJS/Babylon.js](https://github.com/BabylonJS/Babylon.js) | 26.1k | Apache-2.0 | Full web game and rendering engine. | Comparison only (node materials, GUI); don't mix engines. | none |
| [playcanvas/engine](https://github.com/playcanvas/engine) | 16.9k | MIT | WebGL/WebGPU/WebXR runtime built around glTF. | Asset streaming and texture-compression pipeline ideas. | none |
| [CesiumGS/cesium](https://github.com/CesiumGS/cesium) | 15.8k | Apache-2.0 | 3D globes and maps. | If we add a sightings-map globe or real-terrain crash sites. | none |
| [pmndrs/drei](https://github.com/pmndrs/drei) | 9.9k | MIT | Helper components for R3F. | Stars, Sky, Cloud, Sparkles, Environment, PointerLockControls, KeyboardControls, Html, useGLTF, Detailed, Text. | docs |
| [pmndrs/react-three-next](https://github.com/pmndrs/react-three-next) | 2.9k | MIT | R3F + Next.js starter. | Persistent canvas across App Router routes, SSR-safe dynamic import, tunnel-rat. | full |
| [pmndrs/threejs-journey](https://github.com/pmndrs/threejs-journey) | 810 | ⚠️ none (all rights reserved — reference only) | Bruno Simon's Journey demos ported to R3F. | Short recipes: shaders, particles, haunted-house fog. Reference only. | docs |
